name: Desert Warfare
oracle_text:
Whenever you sacrifice a Desert and whenever a Desert card is put into your graveyard from your hand or library, put that card onto the battlefield under your control at the beginning of your next end step.
At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control five or more Deserts, create that many 1/1 red, green, and white Sand Warrior creature tokens. They gain haste.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you sacrifice a Desert and whenever a Desert card is put into your graveyard from your hand or library, put that card onto the battlefield under your control at the beginning of your next end step.
At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control five or more Deserts, create that many 1/1 red, green, and white Sand Warrior creature tokens. They gain haste.

needs.what: a trigger event that fires whenever a card matching a filter (here: a Desert card you own) is put into your graveyard from your hand or library (discard, mill, any other effect), restricted by from-zone, binding the card as subject so a delayed end-step trigger can return it to the battlefield under your control
needs.why_existing_wont_do: discard covers only cards discarded from hand, not other hand-to-graveyard moves; there is no mill or library-to-graveyard event in trigger_events; sacrificed covers the sacrifice half only, and leaves_battlefield sees only permanents

needs.what: a 1/1 red, green, and white Sand Warrior creature token
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has warrior_1_1_r, warrior_1_1_w and elf_warrior_1_1_g, none of which is a three-colour R/G/W Sand Warrior
